description: A Java class for an Android Fragment that demonstrates use of the Camera2 API to capture RAW and JPEG photos, including camera setup, permission handling, capture callbacks, and background processing.

classes.name: Camera2RawFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment demonstrating camera capture with Camera2 API, handling permissions, camera setup, capture callbacks, and background processing.

methods.name: setUpCameraOutputs
methods.description: Configures camera outputs, including ImageReaders for JPEG and RAW, and selects a suitable camera supporting RAW.

methods.name: openCamera
methods.description: Opens the camera device after setting up outputs and checking permissions.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Closes the current camera device and releases resources.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Initiates the process to capture a photo, including pre-capture sequence and capture request.

methods.name: closeCamera
methods.description: Closes the camera device, releases resources, and handles synchronization and locking.

methods.name: startBackgroundThread
methods.description: Starts a background thread and its Handler for camera operations.

methods.name: stopBackgroundThread
methods.description: Stops the background thread and cleans up resources.

methods.name: createCameraPreviewSessionLocked
methods.description: Creates a new CameraCaptureSession for camera preview, configuring output surfaces and starting preview.

methods.name: setup3AControlsLocked
methods.description: Configures auto-focus, auto-exposure, and white balance controls for capture requests.

methods.name: configureTransform
methods.description: Sets up the transformation matrix for TextureView based on device orientation and preview size.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Initiates a still image capture, triggering auto-focus, auto-exposure, and capture request.

methods.name: captureStillPictureLocked
methods.description: Sends a capture request targeting JPEG and RAW outputs, setting orientation and request tags.

methods.name: finishedCaptureLocked
methods.description: Resets auto-focus trigger after capture completion.

methods.name: dequeueAndSaveImage
methods.description: Retrieves the next image from ImageReader, retains resources, and begins saving in background.
